items.title: Tapestry (NYSE:TPR) beats Q3 CY2026 sales expectations, stock jumps 10.3%
items.summary: Luxury fashion conglomerate Tapestry (NYSE:TPR) reported calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027) results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 12.1% year on year to $1.89 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $8.55 billion, close to analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.82 per share was 16.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
